role: Graceful empty/error state of the recovery report for a session with no usable analysis (no HRV metrics, no score): an EmptyState explaining it, with optional Re-analyze and Delete reading actions, above a SubjectiveReadinessCard so the morning still has a takeaway. Shown by MorningResultsView.unreadableSessionState.
types: UnreadableReadingState: struct (View) — the unreadable-reading screen body
toplevel: Stored canReanalyze/canDelete flags, the perceivedReadiness binding, quality and the onReanalyze/onDelete closures, set by the memberwise init.

units.does: ScrollView (padded VStack, spacing 20, app background) with the empty state and a SubjectiveReadinessCard bound to perceivedReadiness with the given quality.
EmptyState 'This reading didn't process' (top padding 40) with Re-analyze when canReanalyze and Delete reading when canDelete; the buttons run onReanalyze / onDelete.
units.entry: EmptyState button taps run onReanalyze / onDelete
